definition: Start from independently displaced C30H22 precursor1-cis, neutral singlet. Preserve the mapped graph. Each Mallory closure joins an ortho position on each aryl flank of one vinyl bridge; enumerate symmetry-inequivalent pairs at both vinyl sites, then second-stage alternatives. Initial nonoxidative closure conserves C30H22; dehydrogenative oxidation removes two specifically mapped H atoms per stage. Compare G only within equal-composition layers or include the same H2/oxidant reservoir explicitly. Primary molecular model gas phase298.15K/1atm; DCM sensitivity may be used. Select one critical closure from each stage for S0 constrained-path and vertical excited-state tracking. Do not demand full nonadiabatic trajectories. If a calibrated excited-state path is unavailable, complete the declared S0/state diagnostic and limit the conclusion to supported candidate sets and ground-state constraints.

candidate_layers.requirement: Two-stage chemically distinct candidate coverage and auditable same-formula energy comparisons.

accessibility_diagnostics.requirement: Real representative closure profiles and physical-state tracking; S0 diagnostics cannot establish a unique photoproduct.

supported_set.requirement: Conclusion remains an evidence-supported candidate set unless a separate calibrated photochemical extension is supplied.
